canonical_work.title: Diversity of wild edible yams and its traditional knowledge among Munda tribe of district Khunti, Jharkhand, India

identity_verification: International Journal of Bioassays volume 4 issue 10 archive lists the article, authors and PDF.
A Government of Jharkhand-hosted PDF manifestation reproduces the article and its citation.
Botanical Survey of India ENVIS bibliography independently indexes the work as Singh & Kumar 2015, Int. J. Bioassays 4(10):4440-4442.

exact_locators.support: article identity; received 2015-08-28, revised 2015-09-06, accepted 2015-09-13; abstract states an ethnobotanical study of nine wild edible Dioscorea taxa in Khunti.
nine-row inventory with botanical name, family, Mundari name, parts used and months of availability.

exact_locators.locator: printed p. 4441, text immediately following Table 1
exact_locators.support: source-reported preparation statement for most yams.
authors thank Munda people of Khunti district for sharing traditional knowledge; this is provenance context, not downstream consent.

rights_access.article_access: journal archive exposes PDF; a Government of Jharkhand-hosted PDF manifestation is discoverable
rights_access.consent: acknowledgement of knowledge sharing does not establish participant/community consent for downstream redistribution

deduplication.manifestation_rule: journal archive, Government of Jharkhand PDF, ResearchGate copies and bibliographic indexes are manifestations/indexes of one canonical work, not independent corroboration

dependency.note: Treat as part of the Singh-Kumar Khunti ethnobotany series; overlapping taxa/propositions across their 2014 aquatic/marshy, 2015 yam, 2016 herbaceous and 2019 Amaranthaceae studies must not be counted as independent corroboration without field-sample/dependency separation.

promotion.reason: Exact locators are established, but redistribution rights, participant/community-consent interpretation, taxonomic/name normalization, series dependency and deterministic MMSC reconciliation remain gating checks.
